Woollam RC2 Ellipsometer
Overview
The RC2 is a variable angle spectroscopic ellipsometer for measuring thickness and optical properties of thin films. Dual rotating compensators allow easy characterization of non-isotropic materials, as well as characterization of structured materials.
Key Features
Spectral measurement in the range of 120nm - 1690nm.
Automated stage allows mapping of samples up to 200mm.
Focusing optics reduce spot size to 120μm.
Camera allows for easy placement of the measurement spot.
